heroHeadline: Visayas Grid Back on Red Alert as Typhoon Queenie Exits PAR Without Landfall
heroSubtitle: NDRRMC's storm-sequence toll still stands at 44 dead, 18 injured and 5 missing (last updated Sept 10). The Visayas grid was placed on red alert Sept 24 (4-9 p.m.) amid coal-plant outages and on yellow alert again Sept 27, with 134 alert days logged in 2026 as of Sept 14. Queenie, the 17th cyclone of 2026, entered PAR Sept 24 and became a typhoon (130 km/h) before exiting Sept 27; no wind signal was raised and PAGASA saw no direct impact.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
